scope: Single HostTiming diagnostic with Present30, NoSharpening and full compute mesh fallback; no performance comparison.

host_timing.method: Logging.cpp405/499: timestamp=steady-now minus loggerorigin. Origin is after launch monotonic and no later than earliest Docker receive minusnativeprefix, after conservative wall mapping. For windowi, start sample precedes logi-1; logi-2 is earlier than that sample, so use logi-2 as lower enclosure and logi as upper. Entire enclosure must fit camera bounds. First2records excluded.
limits: HostTiming global timerthread/allcallbacks, not VI2specific; no causal attribution of presented-frame tails.
Native windows have no exact printed start/end/duration. Enclosures are conservative bounds, not measured duration; no exact pooledCPU or quantile reconstructed.
Host stats p50 uses indexn/2,p99 indexn*99/100; differs from PresentStats nearest-rank.
Vectorpush/allocation, sorts and logging add unmeasured overhead. DKB/GPU_PROFILE absent.

10ms outward wallmapping margin is much larger than observed calibration drift; cannot mathematically exclude an unobserved transient wallclock jump between endpoints. HostmonotonicPRESENT_STATS windows do not use this mapping.

present_limit_activation.scope: Existing present pacing sleeps guest service thread; no game-clock or swap-word override.

pacing.strict_threshold_interpretation: Integer intervals >33333333ns retained unchanged. A cap around33.333ms can increase this fraction through tiny scheduling jitter; inspect quantile amplitudes, not only strict fraction.
pacing.scope: Single Present30 +HostTiming diagnostic with NoSharpening1 +MaxResolutionON, not a causal FPS comparison

activation.source_equals_output_dimensions: Source KeplerCompute::BypassOotNetwork rejects mismatch before successful copy marker; marker prints output dimensions, not two independent measurements.

clock.mapping: Exact mapped libstdc++ disassembly in pacing-steady-clock-proof.json uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC; no libc++ substitution.

visual_review.scene: Kokiri Forest original platform; Link, foliage, terrain, houses and HUD visible before and after camera. No black frame or gross missing geometry seen.
visual_review.limits: Three static1280x720 composite screenshots do not qualify temporal anti-aliasing, visual equivalence or full game quality; no walking.

limits: Same Info logger as earlier AA andPresent30 runs; HostTiming probe added, instrumentation cost unmeasured. No causal gain claim.
Successful copy marker is once-only: proves actual path reached, not per-frame completeness. Source/output equality guarded by exact source before marker; dimensions printed for output only.
No raw shader edits or dispatch removals, frozen1e26 source/executable unchanged.
No averaged/global quantiles; per600-interval nearest-rank windows only.
Not constant30 or full-world, free ground route, audio, save/resume, zone-transition qualification.

source_proof: Native HostTiming collects global wake/event delays; independent from GPU_PROFILE. DKB trace rejected because it also adds GPU timestamp queries/renderer clocks/indirect readbacks.
root_audit: All88enclosures inside monotonicphase; counts/sums and every per-window-statistic range independently checked.
decision: No large HostTiming wake delays shown in selectedwindows. Guest-thread rescheduling after timer callback and host Vulkan presentation remain unmeasured; no clock/sleep tweak justified by these data alone. Need targeted service timing and host output intervals without global DKB effects.
